comparison_conditions.notes: Owner selected three_condition_structured_control on 2026-09-20. The development pipeline now requires raw, neutral structured-control, and Receipt conditions over the same underlying evidence, with versioned assignment/runner/scoring contracts and an explicit structured-control evidence-symmetry audit. This completes only the comparison-condition design gate; the study remains development-only, not frozen, and not executed.

reviewer_population.notes: Owner selected relevant_professional_reviewers on 2026-09-21. Eligibility requires at least one year of relevant practical/professional experience; records 1-2, 3-5, or 6+ years; requires sufficient English; does not require a degree, certification, or job title; permits and records prior general AI Activity Receipt familiarity; applies sealed-case/gold/scoring/protected-analysis exclusions; prohibits external web, AI, people, and outside tools/evidence during study cases. Claims remain limited to the professional population actually recruited. This completes only the reviewer-population methodology gate; recruitment remains unauthorized.

primary_endpoints.notes: Candidate component endpoints exist, but the confirmatory primary endpoint or small prespecified primary set is not frozen.

effect_or_precision_target.notes: No minimally meaningful effect or final precision target has been selected.

crossed_design_power.notes: Design-specific reviewer × case simulation tooling now exists and uses the balanced assignment plus two-way reviewer/case cluster-robust covariance. The gate remains prepared, not complete: primary endpoint/effect target and variance assumptions are not frozen.

sample_allocation_stopping.notes: Reviewer count, case count, cases per reviewer, allocation, and stopping rule are not frozen.

sealed_corpus.notes: Development corpus tooling exists; no fresh sealed confirmatory corpus has been created.

leakage_validation.notes: Mechanical package checks, a leakage/presentation audit, and a bound manual case-methodology review record/validator now exist. A complete manual review must bind to the exact leakage-audit report/build hash, cover every audited case, contain no unresolved automated high-risk flags, and mark semantic leakage, realism, framing neutrality, and answer-option quality acceptable. The checked-in review is a not-run template; the gate remains prepared until the final sealed corpus is audited and manually reviewed.

challenge_strata.notes: integrated_challenge_strata is selected. Ordinary, stale, incomplete, and conflicting strata are represented inside the three-condition crossed development architecture with separate reporting. The gate remains prepared because final sealed stratum counts/allocation, final assignment balance by stratum, and final-corpus leakage/manual review are not frozen or complete.

browser_smoke.notes: Automated/static runner checks pass, but real browser/device/accessibility smoke testing remains open.

reviewer_instructions.notes: Neutral reviewer instructions exist as a draft and are not frozen.

assignment.notes: Balanced seeded assignment tooling exists; final seed/config/order are not frozen.

timing_exclusions.notes: Wall/active instrumentation exists; primary timing definition and technical-exclusion rules are not frozen.

scorer_analysis_plan.notes: Component scorer exists; final statistical analysis handling reviewer/case dependence is not frozen.

ethics_determination.notes: No ethics/REB/IRB review or documented determination has been recorded.

freeze_manifest.notes: Freeze-manifest v0.2 tooling now binds the exact protocol path/version/SHA-256, records whether the protocol is frozen, rejects duplicate artifact paths, computes an aggregate artifact-set SHA-256 and deterministic freeze_content_id, and can fail closed unless protocol.frozen=true. The gate remains prepared: no final confirmatory freeze manifest can exist until all preceding gates are resolved and the actual frozen artifacts are supplied.
